§6Red Copper§f

§aCopper's fancy cousin. Conducts electricity like nobody's business.§f

Toss copper and redstone into the §bBlast Furnace§f and you get §bRed Copper§f. Two ingots per batch. The crucible works too for smaller runs.

This alloy goes into wires, cables, battery sockets, capacitors, and transformers. It's also half of §bAdvanced Alloy§f (steel + red copper in the blast furnace), which is needed for the shredder blades and advanced machines.

Redstone is usually the bottleneck here. Bedrock ore processing helps if you need to scale up production.

§ePS:§f You'll want a steady supply. Red copper is used in nearly every electrical component.
